mindscape_cinemas.name: Open Trauma
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Corin's Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"The young mistress always said, if something's worth doing, it's worth focusing on."
"I've been practicing, and I can do it now!"
"But... are you watching me...?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Atomic Smash
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Corin's EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the target's Physical RES is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Sorry, Mr. or Ms. Ethereal!"
"But I've got work to do... I really am sorry!"
Feeling guilty, Corin sincerely apologizes to the monster — as she wields her savage chainsaw, slicing through the enemies in her way.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Amateur Maid
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: "I—I'll do my best to become a good maid!" Corin said, walking towards the Ethereals, chainsaw in hand.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Battlefield Retainer
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Corin uses a Quick Assist, Defensive Assist, or Chain Attack, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A diligent and serious young maid, Corin always puts her heart and soul into everything she does.
Of course, that includes taking out enemies in combat.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Special Ops Maid
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Uh... sorry, I'm so clumsy. I don't know how to make sure my cuts are even..."
—Said Corin as she looked down at the bits of Ethereal scattered across the ground.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Accumulated Release
mindscape_cinemas.description:
When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Corin knows that she isn't the most powerful of maids, nor the smartest. But she hopes to become the hardest working.
She puts to good use everything she's ever learned.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Insulation Breakdown
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
mindscape_cinemas.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old civillization texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Drink Hot Water
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her flask. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celsius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Stable Arc Barrier
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Youthful Spirit
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Eight Meridians
mindscape_cinemas.description: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Crime Counsel
mindscape_cinemas.description: The maximum uses of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump are increased by one. While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Adapt to the Environment
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the Gnawed state, or when any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when Assault DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG dealt is increased by an additional 50%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Gaze into the abyss, and it gazes back. That's only the first step.
"Then you must approach, enter, and understand it. This is the second step."
"The final step... is to resist becoming it."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Anonymity
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Adapt and Thrive
mindscape_cinemas.description: When any squad member triggers the Assault or Disorder effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Whether you're a hunter or the hunted usually depends on your perspective. However, I favor a more straightforward assessment—"
"The Loser is the prey."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Compulsive Hoarder
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Shady" Technique
mindscape_cinemas.description: While in the Passion state, Jane's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG by 40%. After any squad member inflicts Assault, Jane instantly enters the Passion state, and gains max Passion Stream. When that instance of Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Uplifting Current
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Soukaku triggers Core Passive: Blade Banner or Additional Ability: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
When charged, the special charging module can generate a wind current of Ether energy to charge surrounding Ether devices.
To Soukaku, it's just like having a buffet with friends.
"Guys~ It's all-you-can-eat time!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Experimental Charging Module
mindscape_cinemas.description:
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A charging module is able to continuously accumulate energy during battle.
Therefore, it is regarded as an era-defining conceptual tactical weapon by the R&D department.
But for Soukaku, fully charging it simply means it's time to eat.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Attendance Meal Allowance
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: The best way to motivate Soukaku to train harder is simple: just increase her attendance meal allowance.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Hypothermia
mindscape_cinemas.description: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: The custom-made weapon Oni Banner features a powerful built-in cooling system. Its Ether-infused catalyst generates cold air, dealing significant DMG to enemies it hits.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Late-Night Snacks
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: To further incentivize Soukaku to train is simple: just add a late-night snack top of the attendance meal allowance.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Northern Wind
mindscape_cinemas.description: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Unlocking the safety device within the blade banner allows it to operate at full capacity. It's not just for combat... it's also handy for cooling down a meal.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Greed Burns Like Fire
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Banyue hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: One's Path or EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies' Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar, EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Anger Cuts Like a Blade
mindscape_cinemas.description: The CRIT DMG bonus from the Core Passive is increased by an additional 15%, and the Fire DMG bonus is increased by an additional 15%. While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.
But when it stirs with the wrath of the heavens, even the fiercest of beasts will tremble in fear.

"Anger is like a blade — keep it sheathed in daily life, lest it wound those around you."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Purge Unit - Type Zero
mindscape_cinemas.description: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Student
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Descended Vidyaraja
mindscape_cinemas.description: At any time, when Banyue uses an EX Special Attack, he also gains Vidyaraja. The Fire DMG bonus from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks, Banyue deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using Dodge: Battle Cry immediately after an EX Special Attack also grants Vidyaraja.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.

"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."

mindscape_cinemas.name: "High Spirit"
mindscape_cinemas.description: The maximum stack limit of Electro Prison from Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya increases to 14 stacks. When an Electro Quiver is triggered, 2 consecutive Ha-Oto no Ya will be fired at the target.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I'm not like some stubborn idiots who insist on facing the enemy head-on."
"Be it a straightforward assault or an underhanded attack from the shadows, anything that gets me off work earlier is good in my eyes~"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Languish
mindscape_cinemas.description: When using an Chain Attack or Ultimate, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing Electro Blitz, the DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Don't look at me like that, I'm actually real frail, y'know~"
Harumasa lazily sprawls across his office desk.
"So... how 'bout picking someone else for this mission?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: White Lies
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"...Don't worry, this isn't enough to kill me."
He wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth with a smile and readies his bow once more.
"After all, I'm going to live to make it everyone's problem."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Occasionally Motivated
mindscape_cinemas.description: Electro Prison now lasts for 20s. When Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating Ultimate, apply the maximum stacks of Electro Prison to all on-field enemies.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Harumasa is occasionally full of energy and motivation...
When there's only five minutes left until he can get off work.

mindscape_cinemas.name: No One Knows
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I want vacations, freedom, to be happy every day!"
"Just kidding. I want to live."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Tacit Understanding
mindscape_cinemas.description: After Ha-Oto no Ya hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by Ha-Oto no Ya, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as Electric DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"My master taught me a lot of things, like how to draw a bow, how to wield a blade, and how to survive in this world with this body of mine."
"...What happened after that?"
"Well, after that... he left me."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Qi Shield
mindscape_cinemas.description: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
mindscape_cinemas.description: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: First-Class Head Chef
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Thiren"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Meridian Theory
mindscape_cinemas.description: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
mindscape_cinemas.description: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Every morning is like our first encounter, every night a reunion."
She had once seen fate's fickleness, with the inevitable ending always tainted by tears.
She no longer wishes to be the prophetic bird of disaster. She's willing to vanish in the fire, sleep in the light, and change your fate with all she has.
So, please don't close the window; the bird will bring you love and carry away death.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"If I had never seen the sun, I could have endured the darkness."
The word "savior" feels too heavy, and "good person" seems too light.
So, perhaps it's better to say, you were once her boatman.
In that storm called malice and self-regret, you were a ray of light, guiding her through the flood.
From that moment on, she could no longer bear the curse or the nightmares. She set out on a journey to find you.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Another and the Same"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"We measure each other's shadows with the dusk, discovering they completely overlap."
In countless dusks you were unaware of, she watched the same sun set with you, turning the sea into a beautiful warmth.
Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
mindscape_cinemas.description:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I will lay my true heart, like moonlight, to cover the path beneath your feet."
In chasing after you, she has already formed her own sky.
She is not one of vast love, nor does she have much.
But for you, only for you, she can spill moonlight, cover the darkness, and repair the fractures.
You are her only generosity, her greatest bravery.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Sonnet"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
She is like a bird, flying from late autumn with excitement and anticipation, her wings sweeping across the winter snow. In the spring, she picks a flower and flies straight into the scorching sun of summer.
All because your eyes hide a thousand suns, she loves the fierce sunlight and fears no frost.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Vivian"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Vivian is a love poem written only for you."
"We have all the time in the world."
"So, please allow me to write the rest of my life as your footnotes."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dazzling Entrance
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"You guys are way too honest to be bad guys!"
"All lined up, like NPCs at the shooting range!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Roaming Gunslinger
mindscape_cinemas.description: Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger Perfect Dodges. When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically follow up with a Dodge Counter.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"The Starlight Knights never run from danger. That's what we call tactical repositioning for better aim!"
— User "Dreamgirl Monica" from the Starlight Radiance messageboards.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Never neglect your training, and never stop improving! This is the philosophy of the Starlight Knights. Billy believes in it wholeheartedly, and practices it sincerely.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Starlight Ballistics
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
These explosive bullets of Billy's own invention are incredibly lethal at close range.
Their performance far outstrips Billy's original intention of simply making them cooler.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Lost Technological Construct
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Unknown precision components and unique structural design have given Billy performance far beyond his peers... And maintenance costs far beyond his means.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Starlight Hero
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Hooboy~ Feelin' great! Move aside, Anby, it's my time to shine!"
"Yo, Anby — can you play the Starlight Knight theme?"
—excerpt from Cunning Hares' "Top 10 Forbidden Sentences," selected by Anby

mindscape_cinemas.name: Recharge Chamber
mindscape_cinemas.description:
When the 4th hit of Grace's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Efficiency is the lifeblood of engineering, and within Grace's gun barrel resonates its heartbeat.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Lightning Piercer
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Grace's thrown grenade hits an enemy during a Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Dissecting" complex mechanical structures is Grace's greatest hobby, even in the midst of battle.
How does it feel to get taken apart, with every vulnerability laid bare?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Chief Mechanic
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Grace was personally involved in writing the "Belobog Industries' Construction Safety Guidelines."
She's also the employee who violated the "no dangerous explosives at construction sites" policy the most times.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Burst Capacitor
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Grace uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks). When her Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike or Dash Attack: Quick Inspection hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Anton suspected within the component Grace referred to as the "Electropulse Recycling Module," there was, in fact, an Ether hamster tirelessly generating energy around the clock.
"Can you equip my bro with one too?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Frosty Cold Iron Witch"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: The "Frosty Cold Iron Witch" is capable of taming any mechanical beast, or at least that's what the anonymous fan who came up with the name thinks.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Detonation Trigger
mindscape_cinemas.description: When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The average blood temperature of Belobog Heavy Industries' employees is ninety-eight degrees Celsius. Grace is often viewed as the safety valve keeping them all from boiling.
When even Grace gives up control, it's a sign for everyone to cover their ears.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Spiritual Path
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Fate is ever-changing and the path ahead uncertain. Only a pure, peaceful spirit holds firm. Even through the tides of time, I harbor no regrets."
"The mystic arts take a thousand forms, yet its core stays the same; the road may fork and falter, but the spirit stays steadfast."
"No matter the peril you face or the foe you meet, improvise as needed and face them with composure."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ward Off Misfortune
mindscape_cinemas.description: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Life's twists are unpredictable — at best, the diviner discerns but a fraction."
"Dispelling misfortune and blessing rituals are merely reading the signs to pursue gain and avoid peril."
"Once you understand how to sidestep misfortune, you can just as easily cast it upon your foe... just call forth the calamity they've yet to face."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Cycle of Yin and Yang
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Everything in the world follows laws of mutual generation and restraint; by understanding that principle, you can balance yin and yang to overpower your foes."
"Achieving optimal results with simple techniques isn't cutting corners, but a natural result of following the flow."

mindscape_cinemas.name: The One Path of Mysticism
mindscape_cinemas.description: Activating an  Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"It's said that countless transformations arise from a single principle. In studying the mystic arts, one must not be bound by forms but must grasp their underlying meaning."
"If you can perceive the core principles, each technique flows into another. Such is the path of the mystic: infinite forms converge into unity."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Calm Sky Vigil
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"To master the mystic arts, diligent study and reflection are but the start — you must learn to maintain a pure mind, listening to the wind and watching the clouds."
"When you transcend self and world, your command of Ether grows ever stronger, almost without effort."
"As you persist, you'll be able to maintain inner poise through any trial, meeting any change with unshakable calm."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Swift Yet Still
mindscape_cinemas.description: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Tranquility to govern force, motion and calm coexist. In every movement there lies a pause, and in every pause a potential for energy."
"At any moment, if your mind remains clear, you can meet endless change with unchanging focus — and strike for victory at just the right moment."
"Do you understand?"
"If not, that's okay... after silent contemplation, there comes that instant of awakening. This is yet another expression of 'swift yet still.'"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dreamweave
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The distant, blurred light seemed to be a dream she had crafted, an unreachable future. It wasn't about atonement, but a yearning for freedom.
"You want it too, don't you? A real life." An anonymous former coworker once asked Evelyn.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dance of Fire
mindscape_cinemas.description: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Metamorphosis
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: At that moment, she frees herself from her restraints and becomes her truest self. The tightened ropes snap, and the chains turn into a broken cocoon. Evelyn stands at the boundary of rebirth, and in her cold, sharp gaze, there is the flicker of a faint, soft glow.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Fate's Melody
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Her threads, dyed crimson like the clouds at dawn.
After each attack, she spins elegantly, blazing flames scattering like the morning light. No words are needed — Evelyn's protection has turned into a radiant flame.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Bond of Light and Shadow
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, she additionally executes a Lunalux Garrote follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another Shadowstring Edge will refresh the trigger count.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Where there is light, there will always be shadow.
It silently hides, tracing the light's path, guarding each bright burst. The shadow never tries to steal the light's brilliance, but at every turn, it quietly fills those corners the light cannot reach. The two have never been separated, nor can they be — light is whole because of shadow, and shadow exists because of light. It's an eternal pursuit, an unspeakable connection.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Palmful of Cilantro
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Alice triggers a Polarity Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Sage at the Sword's Tip
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Ultimate: Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarity Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Symmetrism
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Rosemary on Her Lips
mindscape_cinemas.description: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Passion for the Supernatural
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: A Heart of Thyme
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The thyme-scented manor,
The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Rapid Charge Mode
mindscape_cinemas.description: When the 4th hit of Anby's Basic Attack hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Charge up for just a minute, and you're set to fight for an hour!" That's the sales pitch for these weapon expansion modules.
And they deliver exactly that.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Precision Discharge
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Basic Attack: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's EX Special Attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Electric shocks will knock you out cold."
Looking at the enemy out cold at her feet, she added:
"At least, that's what happens in the movies."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Well-Disciplined
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Run, slash, move like lightning. She is no amateur when it comes to Hollows—she's an expert.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Conducting Charge
mindscape_cinemas.description:
When Anby launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy.
For every 12% Energy Generation Rate Anby has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: You won't last long fighting solo. An experienced Hollow Raider knows how to create opportunities for their teammates.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Street Experience
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Working for the Cunning Hares not only builds your mental toughness but also helps (or rather, forces) you to get in shape.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Charging Field
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Anby uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Basic Attack or Dash Attack, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Coils of electricity flickered over her fingertips.
Anby raised her head, eyes brimming with determination beyond her years.
Perhaps, one day, she will be the one with total mastery over electricity.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Spearhead Advance
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a Radiant Aegis shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While Radiant Aegis is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Big Daddy taught me that this is when you form a spearheaded formation with overwhelming force and strike at the enemy's weakest point—"
"And I'll be leading the charge, of course!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Legacy of the Far Lands
mindscape_cinemas.description: While Radiant Aegis from Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Caesar's combat style stands out from those of New Eridu or the Outer Ring, drawing from the techniques of the most skilled warriors among the wanderers.
Knowing when to hold back and when to strike decisively — that has always been the wanderer's way of survival. And Caesar has always been a good student of this philosophy.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Absolute Trust
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Once Caesar recognizes someone as one of her own, she fully accepts them as part of her inner circle. She gives them absolute trust, letting her guard down completely...
Just like she does with you now.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Aries the Battering-Ram
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Caesar uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, she gains 3 additional Assist Points. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash with 1 Assist Point instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
One of the tactics Caesar mastered under the guidance of the wanderers.
"No matter what, I'll fight till the last moment!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Romantic Conquest
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Behind Caesar's carefree and unpolished appearance lies a romantic at heart.
She's always curious about love stories.
But if you dig a little deeper into the subject... you might just catch her blushing.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Overlord's Will
mindscape_cinemas.description: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash and Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target. When Caesar uses EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash or Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I used to keep my eyes straight ahead, thinking that as long as I was strong enough, I could do anything."
"But being a great leader takes more than just power."
"I need to protect my friends behind me — they are the reason I can keep going."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Almighty Qingming Warrior
mindscape_cinemas.description: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Righteous Young Hero
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
mindscape_cinemas.description: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Roar of My Inner Tiger
mindscape_cinemas.description: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Supercharged Bomb
mindscape_cinemas.description: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I've juiced you all up! Go get 'em!"
"Huh? I—I wasn't slacking off, I swear — I just needed a break!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Charging Device
mindscape_cinemas.description: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Never underestimate the value of a single second!"
"Do you have any idea how much extra I can squeeze out of just one second? It's unfathomable!"
"So, can I get a productivity bonus? How about 10%, huh?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: A Hare's Cunning
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Without overpowering might or abundant resources, Nicole depended on her own sharp mind to bring the Cunning Hares to where they are today.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Field Expansion
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"This, and this too — all of this will soon become the Cunning Hares' territory. Do you hear me!"
"W—What? How soon?"
"Uh... in about ten thousand years, based on current revenue projections."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Industry Star
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Though they have plenty of enemies in the industry, Nicole has led her team out of many impossible situations, and so their reputation and experience steadily grew.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Corrupting Energy Field
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: A switch to higher quality ammo with better firepower and increased compressed Etheric Matter leads to higher damage, longer use duration... and higher costs.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Leisure Moment
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Piper's Special Attack: Tire Spin, EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, or Ultimate hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn.
"Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Motivation
mindscape_cinemas.description: During Special Attack: Tire Spin and EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, Piper's movement speed increases. When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Truck Expert
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant:
"100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Refined Techniques
mindscape_cinemas.description: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Personal Hobbies
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Mild Excitement
mindscape_cinemas.description: Increases the duration limit of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin by 2s and extends the duration of Power by 4s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Bird Hunter
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's Physical RES. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Cat & Mouse
mindscape_cinemas.description: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Curious Left Tail
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Sharpen Claws
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Nekomata uses her EX Special Attack, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Lucky Right Tail
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Predator Lineage
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Nekomata launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

mindscape_cinemas.name: Quick Reload
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Zhu Yuan once competed in the Janus Quarter's Public Security Officer Contest, clinching first place with her extraordinary reloading techniques. Her colleague commented: "It's nothing but sheer practice."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ether Ember
mindscape_cinemas.description: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan's Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, deal 10% more Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower Ether DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Zhu Yuan is equipped with Ether bullets specially designed by Public Security, which cause irreversible corruption upon hitting the enemy.
This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...

mindscape_cinemas.name: Public Security Special Training
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ether Perforation
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target's Ether RES.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: When in battle, the gangs in the Hollows often try to quietly calculate how many bullets their enemies have left. What they don't know is that Zhu Yuan's custom magazine can recharge itself with the Ether in the air...

mindscape_cinemas.name: Special Ops Experience
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: A seasoned Public Security Officer excels at reading the battlefield, striking precisely and maximizing combat efficiency. Sometimes, one stern look is enough to make her enemies think twice about putting up a fight.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Expanded Energy Pack III
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next EX Special Attack is reduced by 30. Launching an EX Special Attack will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Zhu Yuan often worries about her gear's remaining battery, getting nervous when the power dips into the red zone and consciously saving power. Public Security finally equipped her with an energy pack that offered both high capacity and long-lasting endurance.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Full Moon Momentum
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Lycaon's EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Records suggest that werewolves exposed to moonlight become significantly more aggressive.
"Don't stare directly at the moon."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Energy Feedback
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's Chain Attack, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Canines receive a brief dopamine boost in their brains after completing semi-complex tasks. At that moment, if their owner pets them to show encouragement, they will be extremely happy..."
—Excerpt from the "Handbook of Unreliable Canine Research"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Attendant Training
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Graceful Demeanor
mindscape_cinemas.description:
If Lycaon is attacked while using a Basic Attack or Special Attack, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.
During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: "An outstanding attendant maintains a graceful demeanor at any and all times."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Alpha Nature
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ruthless Hunter
mindscape_cinemas.description: When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Apologies, but given the circumstances, I will not show any mercy."
"After all, if a fair fight is what you are after, a Hollow is not the place to look for it."

mindscape_cinemas.name: The Champion
mindscape_cinemas.description: Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Victory for the champion is crucial. By facing off against the strongest fighter from the opposing side, he eliminates the threat to his leader — bringing an immense morale uplift to the team.
For him, only victory deserves recognition.
"The Champion cannot be defeated."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Red Scarf
mindscape_cinemas.description: When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
As the "Red Scarf" of the Sons of Calydon, Lighter is quite famous in the Outer Ring, and not just because of his fists, but also due to... his unique way of speaking.
"I enjoy taking it easy... but you wouldn't manage without me, would you?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Mercenary Leader
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: "I'm probably the last person anyone should pick as their leader."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Sunglasses
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: "You're asking why I wear sunglasses? Uh... it's because I get queasy at the sight of blood, I guess."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Decision Maker
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Survivor
mindscape_cinemas.description: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
If given the chance to do it all over again, he would never opt to be the only survivor.
Unfortunately, fate is rarely a choice.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Hibernation Period"
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Light Absorption Technique"
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

mindscape_cinemas.name: "A Story of Sprouting"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Fragrant Tune"
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Seed's Besiege status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and Ultimate DMG increases by 20%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Time to Bloom"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Theory of the Heart"
mindscape_cinemas.description:
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter, fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Warm-Up Exercises
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Drill Attack hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Are you awake? Get spinning, bro!"
"Try and keep up. It's time to do our stretches!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: State of Flow
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Anton uses his EX Special Attack and enters Burst Mode, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his Max HP. While in Burst Mode, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when Burst Mode ends.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
After arduous training, a few lucky individuals will display exceptional vigor and perform above their usual level during high-intensity activities, entering a state of flow commonly known as "being in the zone."
Are you ready to get moving and enter the zone?
— Nitro-Fuel's exclusive program "Good Morning, Zealous Office Workers!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Rotational Training
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but in a complex and ever-changing Hollow worksite, having a wide skillset can present an opportunity to overcome difficulties.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Everyone Get Fired Up!
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Anton uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 12s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Find your rhythm, and let's get moving!"
When Anton starts to get serious, everyone becomes more nimble.
They have to keep up or else they will be training alone the next day.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Jack of All Trades
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!

mindscape_cinemas.name: Break the Limit
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Anton's Piledriver Attack triggers a critical hit, his Basic Attack: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode) and Dodge Counter: Overload Drill (Burst Mode) deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Yeah bro, can you feel the burn?"
Whenever Anton wants to exceed his limits,
his "bro" starts spinning at an astonishing pace, its buzzing echoing Anton's resolution.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Rapid Heat
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Soldier 11 becomes the active character in combat, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Long-term high-intensity combat training allows Soldier 11 to complete mastery of her regulatory systems.
She will always strive to ensure that she's in the best shape for each and every battle.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Scorching Convergence
mindscape_cinemas.description: When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"She may look cold and hard, like a big ice cube... But actually, she's scalding hot inside, like a blazing fire."
— From an anonymous soldier of the Obsidian Division
