"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Director's Cut
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Prequel Protagonist
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Glacial Omen
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Chilling winds are an omen of winter, and a signal that Ellen is about to apply for extended leave to hibernate.
Speaking of which, do sharks actually need to hibernate?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Arctic Ocean Predator
mindscape_cinemas.description: The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami. For each point of Flash Freeze Charge when using an EX Special Attack, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Despite being freshly stained with red, the massive shears held by Ellen lacked any trace of warmth.
The icy cold stems from her iron-forged instrument, as well as the fear of facing a predator such as herself.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Overtime-Intolerant
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The whole point of "efficiency" is being able to go home early and sleep.
So strike harder and strike faster.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Endless Hoarfrost
mindscape_cinemas.description: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A relentless assault of piercing cold. Terrifying monstrosities will learn the beauty and cruelty of winter under Ellen's blade.
But, actually, the endless work that maids have during holidays is far more cruel...

mindscape_cinemas.name: Adequate Sleep
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Except for when in the toughest of battles, Ellen always seems to have that "I can fall asleep at any moment" look.
Many an enemy has met their demise after underestimating Ellen because of it.

mindscape_cinemas.name: The Feast Begins
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: An open wound, a drop of blood. A thrilling hunt, a grand feast. A fragile life, a moment of satisfaction.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Lonely Corruption Symptoms
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Cat's Gaze triggers and hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Feline Go-With-the-Flow
mindscape_cinemas.description:
While Sunna is within any Ether Veil, all squad members gain 10% ATK and obtain 1 Claw Sharpener every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an ATK character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Transformation Apple
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Delusion Investigation Team
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Sunna uses her Ultimate, all squad members deal 18% increased DMG for 60s.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Galaxy Lightway"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Hollow Big Bang
mindscape_cinemas.description:
When Sunna uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Focused Creation! state for 8s.
While in Focused Creation!, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG is increased by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna can trigger Cat's Gaze, its damage being calculated using Attack Agent rules. If Cat's Gaze is triggered while Sunna has a Claw Sharpener, the Claw Sharpener is immediately consumed and Cat's Gaze is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the Focused Creation! state, damage dealt by the entire squad when triggering Cat's Gaze is increased by 50%.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Energy Pulse
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Aria's Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack deals damage to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%.. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dreambeat
mindscape_cinemas.description: During Moment of Delusion, Aria ignores 12% of enemy DEF when attacking or triggering the Abloom effect.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dreamer
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Mechanical Angel
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This can trigger once every 10s.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Tears in the Rain
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Construct's Dream
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180 . After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and Enhanced Charged Attacks deal 30% increased Ether DMG. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Support. This effect can occur once every 6s.
